name: Shibafuji Momiji
source:
[url=/c160944]Misaki[/url]'s mother. Ikebana teacher.

She always takes things at her own pace, and doesn't get rattled easily. Has a graceful and refined personality. Dislikes keeping secrets and tends to speak honestly about everything.

The way her daughter talks about the protagonist so excitedly has also sparked her interest.

[Translated from the [url=https://edoire.jp/products/ikunew/chr/15.html]official website[/url]]
